notes.title: The Cursed Legacy (TCK's sequel) is NOW available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[p][b]The Cursed Legacy[/b], the last Mega Drive/Genesis game (and TCK sequel) from [b]GGS Studio Creation[/b], is now available on Steam.

[b]With a 20% discount for the first 7 days of the game's launch![/b]

🙏Thank you for sharing and supporting the porting of inde retro games to modern platforms.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126270/TCL__The_Cursed_Legacy/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
